set.body:
Outcome: prevent silent changes in predictor-column meaning when canvas dimensions or feature settings differ between training and prediction.

Scope: R/statistics.R, focused tests/testthat coverage, and relevant API documentation. Record ordered predictor names, actual bin boundaries/ranges (including axial wrap and upper-edge rules), weighting and normalization on feature_table output. Supply a minimal model binding or explicit expected training descriptor; arbitrary model training does not reliably retain data-frame attributes. Checked predict_contours must compare actual and expected descriptors before calling either a model or callback, and refuse missing or incompatible descriptors. Any legacy unchecked migration path must be opt-in, visibly warn, and never claim validation. Keep this patch independent of the full specification and new estimators.

Acceptance:
- Reproduce a 100-pixel contour occupying length_6 at 200x200 and length_4 at 2000x2000 with current defaults. Incompatible prediction fails before model execution.
- Compatible training/prediction preserves existing numeric feature values and scores; serialized model bindings retain their descriptors.
- Missing metadata, renamed/reordered predictors, changed bins/ranges, and changed normalization are covered. Geometry-only callbacks receive an explicit migration example.
- Preserve numeric parity references. Attribute-sensitive fixture changes have focused metadata assertions rather than weaker numeric tolerances.
- Provide a reproducible train/bind/predict example and actionable errors identifying mismatched fields.

Dependency: mlv-parity-perf currently owns these paths. Begin only after its completion or a recorded scoped handoff and reservation refresh. Do not close or alter that task to clear this dependency without evidence.
set.title: Reject prediction with missing or incompatible training feature metadata
